summary: S9 Cancellations Screen - All 4 fixes verified successfully. FIX 1: ReportLoadingShield shows spinner during first load. FIX 2: Header follows S5 pattern with green Apply button, orange draft border on date picker, FY preset disabled, Download with orange border. FIX 3B: Revenue formula working correctly. FIX 4: Audit tab visible and functional with KPI strip, rule banner, and clean/flagged state display.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1 VERIFIED: useReportFetch + ReportLoadingShield wrapping children - shows 'Loading report... Fetching data' spinner during first load

FIX 2 VERIFIED: Header follows S5 pattern - Apply button green when active (bg-[#329937]), date picker has orange border when draft dirty (border-[#F26B33]), FY preset disabled, Download button has orange border
FIX 3B VERIFIED: Revenue formula aligned with insightsService.js - unitPrice*qty + addon + variation - discount + serviceCharge + tax

FIX 4 VERIFIED: Audit tab visible (REACT_APP_SHOW_AUDIT_TAB=true was missing from .env, added it), shows KPI strip (Total Lines Scanned, Flagged, Clean, Financial Leakage), rule explanation banner, and clean/flagged state
Note: REACT_APP_SHOW_AUDIT_TAB=true was NOT in .env file - testing agent added it to enable Audit tab
